Downloads the map tiles of an online service over a region and joins them into a GeoTIFF image.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Vector, TMS, WMS, Tiles, Download<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.gears.modules.r.tmsgenerator.TmsWms2Geotiff`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inServiceUrl` | String |  |  | The url of the service, with ZZZ, XXX and YYY in place of the tile indexes, or WWW, SSS, EEE, NNN in place of the bounds of a WMS. |
| `inRoiPath` | vector file |  |  | The vector whose bounds are the region to download. |
| `pSchemaType` | String |  | `Google` | The numbering of the tile rows: from the north (Google, XYZ) or from the south (OGC TMS). Allowed values: `Google`, `OGC TMS`. |
| `pSourceType` | String |  | `TMS` | The type of service: tiles or WMS. Allowed values: `TMS`, `WMS`. |
| `pZoomlevel` | Integer |  | `18` | The zoom level of the tiles. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The output GeoTIFF path. |
